method: Fresh isolated contexts; normal visible controls and digital W/A/S/D. One first-stage legal finish per viewport uses existing public read-only copied-diagnostics policy (~50ms decisions), not human driving. No state/time/outcome/save injection, no physics/AI changes. Desktop viewport emulation, not real phone.
